title: Contact the Lakeside library about study rooms
text:
Booking a library study room from the app was the #1 request from the Westbrook beta. Before we promise it at Lakeside, find out how their room booking works.

*   Email the library's student services desk, ask who manages the room booking system
*   Ask if they use LibCal or something custom, and if there's any way to link to it
*   Even a deep link to the booking page would be a good start for January
